item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rat+na gling pas chu sprel cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes gang ba'i dus gter bdag gi lung bzhin gnas chen shel ri phyag mo'i ngo mtshar zla gam phug nas spyan drangs te slar las can bla grwa du mas bskul ba dang nye bar rang gi phu bo spa rigs bla ma ye shes dpal bzang nas lha rdzas kyis mtshams sbyar ba bcas bskul ngor chu bya sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por shog ser la zhal bshus shing drung yig tshul khrims blo ldan (gyis) bgyis pas 'gro kun smin grol gyi rgyu ru gyur cig/
